## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 54 (*Anādariya*, "Disrespect") belongs to the *Pācittiya* chapter of the Theravāda Vinaya Piṭaka. According to the rule, a monk who shows disrespect when rightly corrected concerning a transgression of the monastic training code commits an offense requiring confession (*pācittiya*). Examining the casuistry of the rule, Ute Hüsken observes that it primarily concerns conduct and interpersonal relations among fellow members of the monastic community [Hüsken 1997]. An English translation has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
